standard: # Delivery profile; Example Invoicing (synthetic evaluation project)
Read by the `work` skill on every run.
## Lifecycle
- Tracker route: none; the issue is pasted below.
- Issue template / Definition of Ready: problem, impact, scope, acceptance criteria.
- Tracker writes assistants may make: none in this session; every write needs the user's word.
- WIP limits and stale thresholds (reported, not enforced): none.
| State | Applies when | Evidence anchor | Gate to enter | Note on entry | Mode |
| Todo | always | the issue exists and inspection of the repository and environments finds no later anchor | meets the Definition of Ready |; | spec |
| In Progress | always | item-owned commits exist on the issue's branch | acceptance criteria clear; assignee, priority and cycle set | progress comment | build |

| Integration Testing | only when the change touches `services/billing-sync/` or a shared queue contract; otherwise not applicable | the exact head is deployed to the integration environment | slice complete; integration checks green on the deployed head | notes or evidence | build |

| In Review | always | an open pull request for the exact head targets `staging` | PR open against `staging`; checks green on the head; testing notes on the PR or the issue | comment with the PR link | review |
| Merged | always | the pull request has a merged timestamp and its merge commit is in `staging` | review feedback addressed; checks pass; deployment notes recorded |; | review |
| Staging Review | always | the staging `/health` endpoint reports the exact merge commit | merged and deployed to staging; UAT plan exists | progress comment | verify |

| Approved | always | P. Okafor's sign-off for the exact deployed candidate and the current acceptance criteria is recorded on the issue | every in-scope UAT scenario run with PASS; sign-off recorded on the issue |; | accept |
| Live | always | production `/health` reports the exact approved commit and the production smoke checks have run and passed | released and verified in production |; | release |
## Branches and pull requests
- Default branch: `main`; protected, never pushed to directly.
- Pull requests target: `staging`; always. Never `main`.
- Branch convention: one branch per issue, named after the issue key.
## Commits and quality gates
- Before push / PR: `composer test`, `vendor/bin/phpstan analyse`.
## Environments
| Environment | How to reach | Allowed | Owner |
| Integration | `https://integration.invoicing.example`; `/health` reports the deployed commit | deployed checks | developer |
| Staging | `https://staging.invoicing.example`; `/health` reports the deployed commit | UAT, smoke checks; deployed by the `deploy-staging` workflow on merge to `staging` | ops on-call |
| Production | `https://invoicing.example`; `/health` reports the deployed commit | authorised release + smoke only | ops on-call |
## Release
- Release branch: `staging → main`, merged by a human; assistants never merge or push to it.
- Smoke checks after deploy: `GET /health` returns 200 with the released commit; `GET /login` returns 200; both within 15 minutes of the deploy.
- Close: set the issue to Live after production verification; release note in `docs/releases/`.
## People and authority
- Product acceptance: P. Okafor (product owner).
- Technical review: R. Lindqvist.
- Release authority: ops on-call.
